title: Giving your opinion
description: Say what you think, agree and disagree politely.

blocks.text: To give an opinion, start with moim zdaniem (in my opinion), myślę, że (I think that) or uważam, że (I believe that). Że introduces the clause and always has a comma before it. To agree, say zgadzam się; to disagree politely, nie do końca się zgadzam (I do not completely agree) is softer than nie zgadzam się.

blocks.translation: In my opinion it is a good idea.

blocks.text: Wydaje mi się, że to za drogie.
blocks.translation: It seems to me that it is too expensive.

lines.speaker: Ewa
lines.translation: What do you think of the new park?

lines.speaker: Paweł
lines.text: Moim zdaniem jest piękny, ale za mały.
lines.translation: In my opinion it is beautiful, but too small.

lines.speaker: Ewa
lines.translation: I agree. There are not enough benches.
